name: RTB Digital Inc. Common Stock
summary: RTB Digital, Inc., doing business as Roundtable, owns and operates a Web3 digital media Software as a Service technology platform that enables media brands and journalists to distribute, publish, monetize, and engage with their communities within brand, data, and voice. It provides sports, crypto, and financial news coverage with distribution partners. The company was formerly known as Roundtable Media, Inc. The company is based in San Diego, California.
